index.hero_p1: Upload your lecture PDF and get a summary and flashcards, ready to go.
index.hero_p2: Review on the right day, before you forget, with spaced repetition.
index.passo1_p: Give each course a name and a color. Everything you upload stays organized there.
index.passo2_p: A PDF with selectable text, up to 10 MB. Then ask for a summary, flashcards, or both.
index.passo3_p: Every day you get the cards you are about to forget. You rate how it went and the next interval adjusts.
index.aviso_ia: Summaries and flashcards are generated by AI and may contain mistakes. Use them as support and check against the original material.
index.rec1_p: Each course with its PDFs, summaries and flashcards, in the color you choose.
index.rec2_p: The key points of the PDF as bullet points, plus questions ready to practice.
index.rec3_p: The SM-2 algorithm decides when each card comes back. Streaks and levels keep the habit going.
index.rec4_p: Practice tests per subject and a leaderboard with friends.
index.gratis_itens:
• 20 AI generations per month
  • Unlimited flashcards and reviews
  • Unlimited subjects
  • Export and delete your data
index.pro_itens:
• 300 AI generations every 30 days
  • Everything in Free
  • Priority generation
  • Card or Pix, no automatic renewal
index.nota_geracao: A “generation” is each summary or set of flashcards created from a PDF. Uploading PDFs, reviewing cards and reading summaries do not use generations.
index.faq1_r: We don't keep the original file. We extract the text, use it to generate the summary and flashcards, and store that text encrypted in your account.
index.faq2_p: Can anyone besides me see my materials?
index.faq2_r: Each piece of content is only accessible to the account that created it. To generate summaries and flashcards, the text is sent to the AI provider, which processes it to return the result. The details are in the Privacy Policy.
index.faq3_r: Yes. Summaries and cards are a study aid and don't replace the original material or your teacher. It's worth double-checking important points before the exam.
index.faq4_p: Does it work with scanned or password-protected PDFs?
index.faq4_r: Not yet. The PDF needs selectable text. Scanned files (images only) and password-protected PDFs can't be read. The limit is 10 MB and 300 pages per file.
index.faq5_r: It means reviewing content at growing intervals: what you know well shows up less and less often, and what you get wrong comes back soon. That way you spend time where you need it.
index.faq6_r: Yes. In “My account” you can download a copy of everything and delete your account and all your content whenever you want.
index.faq7_r: You choose card or Pix and pay in Mercado Pago's secure checkout. Studiy never sees or stores your card details. Pro lasts 30 days and doesn't renew on its own.
index.priv_itens:
• Passwords stored only as hashes, never in plain text
  • Texts, summaries and flashcards encrypted at rest
  • Encrypted connection (HTTPS) in production
  • Export a copy of your data or delete your account whenever you want

termos.b04: Studiy is a platform for organizing your studies by subject and generating, with AI support, summaries and flashcards from PDFs you upload, with spaced-repetition review. By creating an account you confirm you have read these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
termos.b06:
• You must provide truthful information, be over 18 years old (or have a guardian's authorization) and keep your password confidential.
  • You are responsible for activity on your account. Let us know if you suspect unauthorized access.
termos.b08:
• The materials you upload remain yours. You authorize us to process them only to provide the service (extract text, generate summaries and flashcards, and store them for you).
  • Only upload materials you have the right to use. Do not upload third-party copyrighted content without permission.
  • Requests to remove protected content can be sent to [E-MAIL DE CONTATO].
termos.b10: AI-generated results may contain mistakes and do not replace teachers, books or the original material. Studiy does not guarantee exam performance.
termos.b12: It is forbidden to: try to access other people's accounts or data; circumvent plan limits or security measures; overload the service with automation; use Studiy for illegal content; or reverse-engineer the service.
termos.b14: The Free plan includes 20 AI generations per month, counted for each summary or set of flashcards generated. The Pro plan costs R$ 20 per 30-day period and includes 300 generations per month. Payment is made by card or Pix, in Mercado Pago's environment, and does not renew automatically: at the end of the 30 days the plan returns to Free and you can purchase it again (the days of an early renewal are added to the ones you have left). Online purchases carry a 7-day right of withdrawal under the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code; to request a refund, write to [E-MAIL DE CONTATO].
termos.b16: We work to keep the service online, but it may be unavailable due to maintenance or third-party failures (such as the AI provider). We may change features, giving advance notice when the change is significant.
termos.b18: You can delete your account at any time under My account. We may suspend accounts that violate these Terms or put other users' security at risk.
termos.b20: To the extent permitted by law, Studiy is not liable for indirect damages or for decisions made based on AI-generated content. Nothing in these Terms limits the rights guaranteed to consumers by Brazilian law.
termos.b22: These Terms are governed by the laws of Brazil. The courts of the consumer's place of residence have jurisdiction.
privacidade.b03: This policy explains what personal data Studiy processes, why, with whom it is shared and how you exercise your rights, under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD).
privacidade.b05: Bernardo Nóbrega Novaes, responsible for Studiy. Contact for the data protection officer (DPO) and channel to exercise your rights: [E-MAIL DE PRIVACIDADE].

privacidade.b09: The original PDF file is not stored. We keep only the text extracted from it, encrypted. We do not intentionally collect sensitive data: avoid uploading materials with personal data of third parties, health data or data about children.
privacidade.b11:
• AI provider (Anthropic): to generate summaries and flashcards, the text extracted from your PDF is sent to the Anthropic API. Processing may take place outside Brazil (international transfer, art. 33 of the LGPD). Under the provider's commercial terms, data sent through the API is not used to train models; check the current terms at anthropic.com.
  • Hosting and database: Contabo, acting as processor.
  • Email delivery: Brevo, which receives your email address to deliver confirmation and password reset messages.
  • Backups: Backblaze, with servers in the United States (international transfer, art. 33 of the LGPD). Backups are encrypted before upload and Backblaze does not have the key to read them.
  • Payments: Pro plan payments are processed by Mercado Pago, in its own environment. Studiy does not receive or store card numbers or bank details; we keep only the order record (amount, method, date, status and transaction identifier).
  • We do not sell your data or use it for advertising. We may also share data when required by law or by an order from an authority.
privacidade.b13:
• Encrypted connection (HTTPS) in production.
  • Passwords stored only as a hash (bcrypt).
  • PDF text, summaries and flashcards encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM).
  • Isolation between accounts: each piece of content is only accessible to the account that owns it, checked on the server on every request.
  • Sessions renewed every 15 minutes and ended on logout and on password change; limits on login attempts and AI usage.
privacidade.b14: No system is completely immune to failures. In the event of an incident that may cause significant risk or harm, we will notify the ANPD (Brazil's data protection authority) and the affected data subjects, under art. 48 of the LGPD.
privacidade.b16: At any time, you can: confirm whether we process your data; access it; correct it; request anonymization, blocking or deletion; request portability; get information about who we share it with; withdraw consent; and object to processing based on legitimate interest.
privacidade.b17: In the dashboard, under My account, you can export your data (JSON file) and delete your account. For other requests, write to [E-MAIL DE PRIVACIDADE]. You can also file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
privacidade.b19: When you delete your account, we erase your data from the production database, including subjects, texts, summaries, flashcards and usage. Encrypted backup copies are kept for up to 12 months (daily for two weeks, weekly for two months and monthly for one year) and deleted automatically after that; until then, your data may remain in them. Payment records may be kept, without any link to your account, for the period required by tax and legal obligations. We may keep the minimum necessary to meet legal obligations or defend rights.
privacidade.b20: 7. Storage in your browser and third parties
privacidade.b21:
• Session cookies: two HttpOnly cookies (which page scripts cannot read) keep you logged in: an access cookie valid for 15 minutes and a renewal cookie valid for 14 days. Both are deleted when you log out and stop working when you change your password.
  • sessionStorage: keeps only a flag that you are logged in, until you close the tab.
  • localStorage: keeps your theme preference (light/dark), whether you closed the language notice, and a copy of the latest leaderboard so it shows faster.
  • We do not use advertising cookies or behavior analytics tools.
  • Fonts are served by Studiy itself: the pages do not load third-party resources.
privacidade.b23: Studiy is intended for people over 18. Minors under 18 should only use the service with the specific and prominent consent of a parent or legal guardian (art. 14 of the LGPD).
privacidade.b25: Summaries and flashcards are generated by AI and may contain errors or omissions. Check them against the original material before using them for exams or important decisions.
privacidade.b27: We may update this policy. Significant changes will be announced in the dashboard, and the current version always appears at the top of this page.
